title: Which AI Do People Actually Use?
sources: Similarweb worldwide web-visit share, October 2026, as reported by Momentic 'Top AI Chatbots by Market Share November 2026' (published 5 Nov 2026): order ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Grok, Perplexity, Copilot. Web visits only; excludes apps and API use; Meta AI is not in the ranking. The video says 'website traffic', never 'users'.

Similarweb, 'AI Search Stats 2026' (29 Jul 2026): ChatGPT's share of generative-AI web traffic fell from about three quarters in June 2025 to about half by May 2026; Gemini's rose from under a tenth to over a quarter; Claude's rose to close to a tenth.

TechCrunch, 'ChatGPT's market share slips below 50% for first time' (16 Jun 2026), citing Sensor Tower State of AI Report 2026: top three by monthly users ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude; Grok, Perplexity, DeepSeek and Meta AI each under 5%.
Stable facts: Grok is made by xAI and built into X; DeepSeek is a Chinese lab known for open models; Claude is made by Anthropic; Gemini is Google's assistant; ChatGPT is made by OpenAI.
TO RE-CHECK before publishing: positions four and five depend on the measure (web visits). Open the Similarweb report itself to confirm the October order.

lines.text: There are hundreds of AI tools out there, but which ones do people actually use?
lines.caps: hundreds of *AI tools | which do people *actually use?

lines.text: I looked at website traffic from October, and here's the top five, counting down.
Number five is Grok, the assistant from x A I that lives inside X.
Number four is DeepSeek, from a Chinese lab known for its open models.
Number three is Claude, from Anthropic, known for writing and coding.
Number two is Gemini, Google's assistant, which has climbed fast all year.
And number one is still ChatGPT, from OpenAI, though its share has shrunk over the past year.
Which one is on your phone?
